channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] Meta settles social media addiction trial with states for up to $17B
item.description: Meta and a coalition of state attorneys general reached a settlement in the high-profile trial accusing the company of designing its platforms to be addictive for young users, according to court filings published Wednesday. The proposed settlement, later announced by California Attorney General Rob Bonta (D), will require Meta to make various changes to its [...]

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Prince Harry and wife Meghan arrive in the UK as they make a fresh start
item.description: Prince Harry and his wife Meghan arrived in the United Kingdom on Wednesday, as they make a fresh start in Britain after six years in the United States, U.K. media reported.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] California couple confronts their surrogate in Texas court as dispute over newborn escalates
item.description: A California couple in an escalating fight with their surrogate over a newborn with a life-threatening heart defect have testified in a Texas court.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tim Curry, 'Rocky Horror Picture Show,' 'Home Alone 2' actor, dead at age 80
item.description: Actor Tim Curry, known for standout performances in “Rocky Horror Picture Show” and “It,” has died at 80 after decades in film and theater.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Democratic states file new lawsuit seeking to block Trump’s order limiting mail voting in midterms
item.description: Democratic-controlled states have filed a new lawsuit to block President Donald Trump’s executive order seeking to limit mail voting in this year’s midterm elections.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 5-year-old boy detained in viral Texas video deported to Mexico with father
item.description: Family attorneys say ICE denied a father’s request to release his 5-year-old son to his mother before deporting both to Mexico.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Researchers warn type 2 diabetes is rising rapidly among children and teens
item.description: A new study warns type 2 diabetes is becoming increasingly common and more aggressive among children and teenagers in the U.S.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] At least 75 killed and hundreds missing after flash floods in Nepal and China
item.description: Flash floods in a border area of Nepal and China have killed at least 75 people and left hundreds missing.
